title: The Wrong Queen
setup: Your pawn steps to the eighth rank this move, with the black king on g7 and its queen on c7.
hint: A new queen changes nothing here. Ask which piece would check the king from the promotion square.
explanation:
## The Idea

A queen on e8 gives no check at all, and Black simply plays on with the position level. {{e8=N+}} hits g7 and c7 at once, Black must answer the check, and the queen falls next move. Promote to whatever the position needs, not to whatever is biggest.
